section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION - IRS Type Rear Axle Shaft
ocr_text:
RA-8
REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION - IRS Type Rear Axle Shaft

3. PACK BEARINGS WITH MP GREASE NO. 2
• Use a pressure bearing lubricator if available.
OR
• Place bearings in a handful of grease. Force grease into the bearing until completely filled.

4. INSTALL INSIDE BEARING OUTER RACE
(a) Using SST, install the bearing inside outer race in the rear axle housing.
SST 09950-22011 (09550-00020, 09550-00040)
(b) Install the bearing.

5. INSTALL NEW INNER OIL SEAL
(a) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal to a depth of 31 mm (1.22 in.).
SST 09550-22011 (09550-00020, 09550-00040)
(b) Apply MP grease No. 2 to the oil seal lip.

6. INSTALL OUTSIDE BEARING OUTER RACE
Using SST, install the bearing outside outer race in the rear axle housing.
SST 09550-22011 (09550-00020, 09550-00050)

7. PACK INSIDE OF REAR AXLE HOUSING WITH MP GREASE NO. 2

8. COAT OUTSIDE OF NEW SPACER WITH MP GREASE NO. 2

9. INSTALL NEW SPACER INTO HUB
